blocks.text: With a lighter, sleeker and more stylish design, Galaxy A56 5G comes loaded with features that make doing awesome things easy. The triple-lens camera lets you capture amazing photos and videos, whether you are shooting lush landscapes or adorable selfies. With Awesome Intelligence, you can easily edit out unwanted objects or make sure everyone looks their best in a group photo. And with tons of internal storage, you can keep more of your favorite memories. 5G connectivity makes browsing, sharing and streaming a breeze. Plus, the Super AMOLED display brings all your favorite content to life in bright, vivid detail. And while you’re doing it all, Knox Security keeps your personal info private and safe.1Requires internet connection; results may vary by uniqueness, clarity and framing of circled image and related factors2Measured diagonally, the screen size is 6.7” in the full rectangle and 6.5” accounting for the rounded corners. items.label: AWESOMELY LIGHT
items.value: The sleeker, lighter design of Galaxy A56 5G makes it easier and more comfortable to hold as you browse, snap and share as compared to Galaxy A54 5G.

items.label: AWESOME MADE EASY
items.value: The Awesome Intelligence of Galaxy A56 is like having a suite of superpowers. You can find answers quicker using Circle to Search with Google.7 Plus, get the photos and videos you want with tools like Best Face and Auto Trim .

items.label: AWESOMELY VIVID DETAIL
items.value: The ultra-clear 6.7” display of Galaxy A56 5G helps you enjoy the latest shows, your favorite pics or fun social videos in awesome detail.2

items.label: DELIGHT IN THE DETAILS
items.value: Galaxy A56 5G comes equipped with a triple-lens camera. A 50MP main camera gets great details, even at a distance. The 12MP wide camera allows you to get stunning clarity in your broader shots.

items.label: LASTS LONG. CHARGES FAST
items.value: The 5,000mAh battery in Galaxy A56 5G lets you do what you want without worrying about running out of power. And the 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0 recharges your phone faster so you can get back to doing awesome things faster.3

items.label: THE SPEED YOU NEED
items.value: Galaxy A56 5G keeps you connected with faster speeds so you can enjoy every online experience with ease.4 Stream videos, share photos, video call or simply surf your favorite sites without interruption.

items.label: KEEP YOUR DATA SAFE
items.value: Never worry about a security breach with Samsung Knox, especially with the included six years of OS / security updates.5 This multilayered security platform keeps all your private files and data safeguarded.

items.label: DESIGNED TOUGH
items.value: Galaxy A56 5G looks great, but it’s also built tough. With a metal frame and a Gorilla Glass Victus+ screen, this phone is designed to stand up to everyday use. Plus, the improved IP67 rating means A56 5G can stand up to dust and water.6

items.label: KEEP EVERY MEMORY
items.value: With improved internal storage options of either 128GB or 256GB, Galaxy A56 5G lets you keep your favorite pics, videos and memories.7
